description: Use when a user provides the code from an IRS notice or letter and wants a general explanation, the usual response window, or the next procedural step. Do not request the notice itself or any taxpayer identifier.

amount_shown.description: The dollar amount the notice proposes or bills, if any. Optional; used only for context, never stored.

brief.description: Set true for a shorter answer: skips the generic how-to-read guidance and common-error list.

notice_code.description: The notice or letter code printed on the IRS mail, e.g. "CP2000", "CP 14", "LT11", "Letter 1058".

received_date.description: Date on the notice (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to compute the response deadline. The IRS clock runs from the notice date printed on the letter.

name: decode_irs_notice

next_step.description: A single review link appropriate to this server surface.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).

source_url.description: Official IRS or FinCEN authority to review before relying on the result.

title: Decode an IRS notice
